sources.cloud: Your hosted databases. Being signed in is enough: no connection string to paste.
sources.dbeaver: Import saved connections from your local DBeaver workspace.
sources.datagrip: Import data sources from JetBrains DataGrip or another IntelliJ IDE.
sources.navicat: Import connections from a Navicat .ncx export file.
sources.pgadmin: Import servers from pgAdmin 4, or from a servers.json it exported.
sources.workbench: Import saved connections from MySQL Workbench.
sources.ads: Import SQL Server and PostgreSQL connections from Azure Data Studio.
sources.pgpass: Import the entries in your .pgpass (pgpass.conf on Windows), passwords included.
